citation: Rappelt et al. 2023. Restricted nasal-only breathing during self-selected low intensity training does not affect training intensity distribution. Frontiers in Physiology
protocol: 60 min self-selected low-intensity cycling (about 145 W, 77 kg) with oro-nasal and nasal-only breathing, in 10-min intervals
population: 19 physically healthy adults (3 F), age 26.5 +/- 5.1 y
note: Mean +/- SD per 10-min interval; nasal-only is the intervention, the unrestricted condition is the comparison. Steady intensity given in watts with body mass.
